doc_lines: Full investment snapshot for one company — quote, financial health, analyst
consensus, earnings, and revenue segmentation.
Args:
symbol: US "AAPL", A-share "600519.SH", HK "0700.HK".
Historical daily OHLCV bars for one stock — for price history, trends, returns,
and charting.
Args:
symbol: US "AAPL", A-share "600519.SH", HK "0700.HK".
start_date: Start "YYYY-MM-DD" (optional).
end_date: End "YYYY-MM-DD" (optional).
limit: Max records when no date range is given (default 60 trading days).
Top US market movers — the biggest daily gainers or losers among tickers with
significant volume. US market only.
Args:
direction: "gainers" or "losers" (default "gainers").
Market snapshot for a region on a single trading day — index closes with
day moves, plus daily sector performance for the US. Defaults to the
latest trading day; pass a date to reconstruct that day's market picture.
Args:
region: "us" (default), "cn", "hk", "jp", "uk", "eu", or "global".
Sector breakdown is US only.
indices: Explicit index symbols overriding the region basket (e.g. ["^VIX"]).
date: Snapshot date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: latest trading day).
A non-trading date falls back to the prior trading day.
Options contracts for an underlying with each one's latest session price, IV,
delta and open interest, filterable by type, expiration range, and strike.
US-listed options only; not for non-US underlyings.
Args:
underlying: Underlying ticker (e.g. "AAPL", "TSLA").
contract_type: "call" or "put" (default: both).
expiration_date_gte: Min expiration "YYYY-MM-DD".
expiration_date_lte: Max expiration "YYYY-MM-DD".
strike_min: Min strike filter.
strike_max: Max strike filter.
limit: Max contracts (default 20).
Real-time quotes only — cheap and fast. Call it freely whenever you need the
current price, including a re-check right before stating a price in your answer.
Args:
symbols: Up to 20 tickers — US "NVDA", A-share "600519.SH", HK "0700.HK".
asset_type: "stocks" (default) or "indices" for index symbols like "^GSPC".
Screen/discover stocks by market cap, price, volume, beta, dividend, sector,
industry, exchange and country via the FMP company screener. Funds and ETFs
are left out unless is_etf or is_fund is True.
Thresholds compare in each listing's own currency (yen on a JP screen), and
London prices and dividends in pence.
Args:
market_cap_more_than: e.g. 1e9 for $1B on a US listing.
dividend_more_than, dividend_lower_than: Annual dividend per share, not a yield.
sector: e.g. "Technology", "Healthcare", "Financial Services".
industry: e.g. "Software", "Biotechnology".
exchange: e.g. "NASDAQ", "NYSE", "AMEX".
country: Issuer's domicile, e.g. "US", "CN", "GB"; keeps its listings on
that country's own exchanges. For listings abroad (ADRs), pass exchange.
limit: Max results (default 50).
Fetch historical dividend payments and stock splits.
Args:
symbol: Ticker — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source, data_type, fallback_from?}. data is
{dividends, splits}, each a list, newest first; count is the total
across both. dividends fields: date, recordDate, paymentDate,
declarationDate, adjDividend (split-adjusted), dividend (as paid), yield
(percent, 0.34 = 0.34%), frequency. splits fields: date, numerator,
denominator. Field names are FMP-native camelCase; date is "YYYY-MM-DD".
fallback_from: source that failed before FMP answered. On error:
{error: <code>, detail, symbol}.
Fetch raw historical key metrics and financial ratios.
Args:
symbol: Ticker, e.g. "AAPL", "0700.HK", "600519.SH".
period: "annual" | "quarter".
limit: Number of periods (default 10).
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source, data_type, period, fallback_from?,
note?}. data is {key_metrics, ratios}: period records, newest first.
key_metrics fields: marketCap, enterpriseValue, evToEBITDA,
freeCashFlowYield. ratios fields: netProfitMargin, returnOnEquity,
currentRatio, debtToEquityRatio, priceToEarningsRatio. source "tushare"
rows lack price-based fields (see get_historical_valuation). date is
"YYYY-MM-DD". Quarter rows: flow-based fields cover that quarter alone;
P/E fields annualize its EPS (x4). fallback_from: source that failed
before FMP answered. An empty quarterly read adds a note. On error:
{error: <code>, detail, symbol}.
Fetch raw historical financial statements for trend analysis or model
building. statement_type="all" returns income, balance sheet, and cash flow.
Args:
symbol: Ticker, e.g. "AAPL", "0700.HK", "600519.SH".
statement_type: "income" | "balance" | "cash" | "all".
period: "annual" | "quarter".
limit: Number of periods (default 10).
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source, data_type, statement_type, period,
fallback_from?, note?}. One statement_type → a list of period records;
"all" → {income_statement, balance_sheet, cash_flow} lists with count the
total. Common camelCase fields: date, revenue, netIncome, eps,
totalAssets, operatingCashFlow. date is "YYYY-MM-DD"; records are
newest-first. fallback_from: source that failed before FMP answered.
An empty quarterly read adds a note. On error: {error: <code>, detail,
symbol}.
Fetch raw historical growth rates.
Args:
symbol: Ticker, e.g. "AAPL", "0700.HK", "600519.SH".
period: "annual" | "quarter".
limit: Number of periods (default 10).
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source, data_type, period, fallback_from?,
note?}. data is {financial_growth, income_statement_growth}, each a
list, newest first; count is the total. financial_growth fields: date,
revenueGrowth, netIncomeGrowth, epsgrowth; income_statement_growth
fields: date, growthRevenue, growthNetIncome, growthEPS. Growth values
are decimal fractions (0.1 = 10%); a quarter row grows on the prior
quarter, not the year-ago one. Field names are FMP-native camelCase; date is
"YYYY-MM-DD". fallback_from: source that failed before FMP answered.
An empty quarterly read adds a note. On error: {error: <code>, detail,
symbol}.
Fetch DCF fair value and enterprise value history.
Args:
symbol: Ticker, e.g. "AAPL", "0700.HK", "600519.SH".
period: "annual" | "quarter".
limit: Number of periods (default 10).
Returns:
dict: {symbol, currency, count, data, source, data_type, period}. data
is {current_dcf, historical_dcf, enterprise_value}, each a list; count
is the total. current_dcf fields: symbol, date, dcf, stockPrice, per
share in `currency` (absent when the venue is unknown). historical_dcf
is always []. enterprise_value fields, newest first: date,
reportedCurrency, stockPrice, marketCapitalization, enterpriseValue,
priced in reportedCurrency (the filings' currency, which can differ
from `currency`; null when unknown). Field names are FMP-native
camelCase; date is "YYYY-MM-DD".
On error: {error: <code>, detail, symbol}.
Fetch insider transactions from SEC Form 4 filings, with quarterly totals.
HK and A-share listings return empty lists.
Args:
symbol: Ticker, e.g. "AAPL".
limit: Number of recent transactions (default 50).
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source, data_type}. data is {trades, stats},
each a list; count is the total across both. trades fields, newest
first: filingDate, transactionDate, reportingName, transactionType,
securitiesTransacted, price. Only "P-Purchase" and "S-Sale" are
open-market trades; others are awards, exercises or tax withholding.
stats, one row per calendar quarter: year, quarter, totalPurchases,
totalSales (counts of P and S trades), totalAcquired, totalDisposed
(shares, all transaction types). Field names are FMP-native camelCase;
dates are "YYYY-MM-DD". On error: {error: <code>, detail, symbol}.
Fetch key executives with title and compensation — identify the
management team or compare executive pay across peers.
Args:
symbol: Ticker — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source, data_type, fallback_from?}. data is
a list of executive records; count is the record total. Fields: name,
title, pay, currencyPay, gender, yearBorn, titleSince. Field names are
FMP-native camelCase; pay is an integer in currencyPay units; not
time-ordered. fallback_from: source that failed before FMP answered.
On error: {error: <code>, detail, symbol}.
Fetch shares float, outstanding shares, and float percentage.
Args:
symbol: Ticker — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source, data_type, fallback_from?}. data is
a list of records; count is the record total. Fields: symbol, date, freeFloat
(percent, 99.8 = 99.8%), floatShares, outstandingShares; an ADR counts
ADS units, not ordinary shares. date is "YYYY-MM-DD": the day FMP
refreshed the record, not the as-of date of the counts, which can be
months older; an A-share row's date is the trading day of its counts.
Field names are FMP-native camelCase. fallback_from: source that failed
before FMP answered. On error: {error: <code>, detail, symbol}.
Fetch a technical indicator time series over OHLCV bars.
Args:
symbol: Ticker, e.g. "AAPL", "0700.HK", "600519.SH".
indicator: FMP name — "rsi", "ema", "sma", "wma", "adx", "williams".
period: Lookback length (default 14).
timeframe: FMP-native bar — "1min"…"4hour", "1day" (default "1day").
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source, data_type, indicator, period,
timeframe, price_treatment, in_progress?}. data: list of {date, open,
high, low, close, volume, <indicator>} newest first, field names
FMP-native camelCase. date is "YYYY-MM-DD" (1day) or
"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (intraday). price_treatment:
raw|split_adjusted|dividend_adjusted. in_progress: date of the newest
bar while it forms. On error: {error: <code>, detail, symbol}.
Fetch the earnings calendar for all companies reporting in a date range —
build a catalyst calendar.
Reads about a month in peak season. Rows carry no market cap; yf_market
get_earnings_calendar ranks US listings by it.
Args:
from_date: "YYYY-MM-DD".
to_date: "YYYY-MM-DD".
Returns:
dict: {count, data, source, data_type, from_date, to_date, truncated?}. data
is a list of reporter records, oldest first. Fields: symbol, date,
epsActual, epsEstimated, revenueActual, revenueEstimated, lastUpdated.
Amounts are in each listing's own currency, not converted (a suffixed
symbol such as 7203.T is non-US): compare only within one currency. date
is "YYYY-MM-DD". truncated: true if a size cap cut the latest dates. On
error: {error: <code>, detail}.
Fetch economic events, such as Fed meetings, jobs reports, and CPI releases.
Reads about two years at most.
Args:
from_date: "YYYY-MM-DD" (default: yesterday UTC, or 7 days before an
earlier to_date).
to_date: "YYYY-MM-DD" (default: 7 days after from_date).
Returns:
dict: {count, data, source, data_type, timezone, from_date, to_date,
truncated?}. data is a list of events, oldest first: date, country, event,
currency, previous, estimate, actual, change, changePercentage, impact,
unit. actual is null before release; change and changePercentage (null
before release) compare actual with previous, not estimate. date is UTC
"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS". truncated: true if a size cap cut the latest dates.
On error: {error: <code>, detail}.
Fetch a US economic indicator series: GDP, CPI, unemployment, Fed funds.
Reads about 16 years at most.
Args:
name: "GDP", "CPI", "unemploymentRate", "federalFundsRate", "inflationRate"
(10Y breakeven, not CPI), "retailSales", "consumerSentiment",
"nonFarmPayrolls".
limit: Observation count (default 50).
Returns:
dict: {count, data, source, data_type, indicator, series?, missing_periods?,
truncated?}. data is {date, value} levels, newest-first; date is the period
start; CPI is an index (YoY %: 100 * (value / same month a year ago - 1),
matched by date). series: country, unit, frequency, adjustment;
missing_periods: absent months or quarters. truncated: true if a size
cap cut the oldest rows. On error: {error: <code>, detail, indicator}.
Fetch market risk premium by country for CAPM/WACC — get the equity risk
premium for a DCF cost of equity, or compare premiums across markets.
Returns:
dict: {count, data, source, data_type, method, as_of}. data is a list of
country records; count is the record total. Fields: country, continent,
countryRiskPremium, totalEquityRiskPremium. Premiums are percent (5.5 =
5.5%). as_of is null: cite method (the source table) and report the figure
as undated. On error: {error: <code>, detail}.
Fetch US Treasury rates across the yield curve (1M to 30Y): the risk-free
rate for DCF/WACC (typically 10Y), the curve shape, or rate trends.
Reads about two years at most.
Args:
from_date: Start date "YYYY-MM-DD" (default: recent data).
to_date: End date "YYYY-MM-DD" (default: today).
Returns:
dict: {count, data, source, data_type, from_date, to_date, truncated?}.
data: list of daily {date, month1, month2, month3, month6, year1, year2,
year3, year5, year7, year10, year20, year30}, newest first; rates in
percent (4.5 = 4.5%); date "YYYY-MM-DD". truncated: true if a size cap
cut the oldest rows. On error: {error: <code>, detail}.
List an underlying's options contracts; use to find contract tickers.
US-listed underlyings only; a listing on a known non-US venue is refused.
Args:
underlying_ticker: Underlying stock ticker, e.g. "AAPL".
contract_type: "call" or "put" (default: both).
expiration_date_gte: Min expiration "YYYY-MM-DD".
expiration_date_lte: Max expiration "YYYY-MM-DD".
strike_price_gte: Min strike price.
strike_price_lte: Max strike price.
limit: Max contracts (default 50, max 1000).
Returns:
dict: {symbol, underlying_ticker, currency?, timezone, count, data,
source, truncated?}. data: list of {ticker, contract_type,
expiration_date, strike_price, shares_per_contract, primary_exchange};
strike_price in `currency` major units. truncated: true if more
contracts match than limit. On error: {error: <code>, detail}.
Fetch OHLCV bars for one options contract.
Intervals: 1min|5min|15min|30min|1hour|4hour|1day|1week|1month (aliases like
"1d"/"daily" accepted).
Args:
options_ticker: OCC contract ticker, e.g. "O:AAPL260618C00220000".
from_date: Start date "YYYY-MM-DD".
to_date: End date "YYYY-MM-DD".
interval: One of the intervals above.
Returns:
dict: {symbol, interval, currency, timezone, count, data, source,
truncated?}. symbol echoes the contract ticker; currency/timezone are the
underlying's. data: list of {date, open, high, low, close, volume}
ascending (oldest first); date exchange-local "YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM:SS]";
prices in `currency` major units. truncated: true if a size cap cut the
oldest bars. On error: {error: <code>, detail}.
Options snapshots: session prices, greeks, IV and open interest.
Args:
options_tickers: OCC tickers, comma-separated, e.g. "O:AAPL260618C00220000".
Returns:
dict: {currency?, timezone?, count, data, source}. data: list of
{ticker, name, market_status, session, greeks, implied_volatility,
open_interest, break_even_price, underlying_asset, last_quote,
last_trade}, keys if known.
session: OHLCV, change, timeframe ("DELAYED": 15 min), last_updated
(when the feed showed it), stale (true: not traded this session;
close, change, volume are the last_updated day's); an undated session
may be from any past day. greeks {delta, gamma, theta, vega};
implied_volatility decimal; underlying_asset {ticker, price,
last_updated, timeframe}. Times exchange-local "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS";
prices in `currency` major units. On error: {error: <code>, detail}.
Fetch OHLCV bars for a stock, commodity, crypto, or forex pair.
Intervals: 1min|5min|1hour|1day; intraday needs dates.
Args:
symbol: Commodity "GCUSD", crypto "BTCUSD", forex "EURUSD".
asset_type: stock|commodity|crypto|forex.
interval: See above.
from_date: "YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM]".
to_date: Same format.
Returns:
dict: {symbol, asset_type, interval, currency?, timezone, count, data,
source, price_treatment, name?, in_progress?, truncated?, incomplete?}.
data: list of {date, open, high, low, close, volume} ascending; date
exchange-local "YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM:SS]"; prices in `currency` major
units. price_treatment: raw|split_adjusted|dividend_adjusted.
in_progress: date of a forming last bar. truncated: true if a size cap
cut the oldest bars. incomplete: true if bars in the window are missing.
On error: {error: <code>, detail}.
Fetch short interest and/or short volume for a US stock.
Short interest is FINRA bi-monthly (settlement_date); short volume is daily
off-exchange (date).
Args:
symbol: Stock ticker, e.g. "AAPL".
data_type: "short_interest", "short_volume", or "both" (default).
from_date: "YYYY-MM-DD" start filter (optional).
to_date: "YYYY-MM-DD" end filter (optional).
limit: Max records per section (default 20, max 50000).
Returns:
dict: {symbol, timezone, count, data, source, data_type}. data is a dict
of {short_interest, short_volume} lists (requested sections only), newest
first. Record fields are vendor-native (e.g. settlement_date);
short_volume_ratio is a percent (43.3 = 43.3%). Partial failures appear
in an `errors` map. On error: {error: <code>, detail}.
Fetch OHLCV price bars for a stock.
Intervals: 1min|5min|15min|30min|1hour|4hour|1day. Intraday needs start_date
and end_date.
Args:
symbol: Ticker — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH", LSE "VOD.L".
interval: See above.
start_date: "YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM]".
end_date: Same format.
Returns:
dict: {symbol, interval, currency?, timezone, count, data, source,
price_treatment, name?, in_progress?, truncated?, incomplete?}. data:
list of {date, open, high, low, close, volume} ascending (oldest first);
date exchange-local "YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM:SS]"; prices in `currency` major
units. price_treatment: raw|split_adjusted|dividend_adjusted.
in_progress: date of a forming last bar; some daily feeds omit it.
truncated: true if a size cap cut the oldest bars. incomplete: true if
bars in the window are missing. On error: {error: <code>, detail}.
Analyst price-target summary for a stock. Use for consensus target vs.
current price.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a single Yahoo-native
record {current, low, high, mean, median}; price values are as reported
by Yahoo (minor units on some venues, e.g. LSE pence) and currency is
omitted — no declared-currency source on this path. count is 1 when data
exists, else 0 (empty {} when unavailable). On error:
{error, detail, symbol} with error upstream_error.
Aggregated analyst recommendation counts by period. Use to gauge the
buy/hold/sell balance over recent periods.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of Yahoo-native
records {period, strongbuy, buy, hold, sell, strongsell} in Yahoo's
order (period "0m" current, "-1m", "-2m", "-3m"). Empty data means none
published. On error: {error, detail, symbol} with error upstream_error.
Forward EPS estimates by period.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of Yahoo-native
records, one per period {period (0q, +1q, 0y, +1y), period_end?,
numberofanalysts, avg, low, high, yearagoeps, growth, methodology?,
year_ago_stale?} in Yahoo's period order; growth is a fraction (0.07
= 7%). methodology (gaap or normalized, a non-GAAP basis) is the basis
of every EPS figure; do not compare across bases. year_ago_stale: true
when the year-ago basis is out of date; yearagoeps and growth are then
null and period_end may still name the period just reported. Empty
data means none published. On error: {error, detail, symbol} with error
upstream_error.
Historical EPS estimate vs. actual with surprise. Use to review recent
earnings beats/misses. Same data as get_earnings_data (fundamentals server).
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of Yahoo-native
records {quarter, epsestimate, epsactual, epsdifference,
surprisepercent, methodology?} in Yahoo's order (oldest first); quarter
is "YYYY-MM-DD". methodology (gaap or normalized, a non-GAAP basis) is
the basis of every EPS figure; do not compare across bases. Empty data
means none reported. On error: {error, detail, symbol} with error
upstream_error.
Growth estimates for the stock vs. the index.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of Yahoo-native
records, one per period {period (0q, +1q, 0y, +1y, LTG), period_end?,
stocktrend, indextrend, year_ago_stale?} in Yahoo's period order; the
trends are fractions (0.07 = 7%). year_ago_stale: true when the
year-ago basis is out of date; stocktrend is then null and period_end
may still name the period just reported. Empty data means none
published. On error: {error, detail, symbol} with error
upstream_error.
Current insiders and their holdings. Use to see who the insiders are and
their share positions.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of Yahoo-native
records {name, position, url, most_recent_transaction,
latest_transaction_date, shares_owned_directly,
shares_owned_indirectly, ...} in Yahoo's order; date fields are
"YYYY-MM-DD". Empty data means none reported. On error:
{error, detail, symbol} with error upstream_error.
Recent insider buy/sell transactions. Use to track insider activity.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of Yahoo-native
records {start_date, insider, position, url, transaction, text, shares,
value, ownership} in Yahoo's order (most recent first); start_date is
"YYYY-MM-DD". Empty data means none reported. On error:
{error, detail, symbol} with error upstream_error.
Top institutional holders of a stock. Use to see which institutions hold
the largest positions.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of Yahoo-native
records {date_reported, holder, shares, value, pctheld} in Yahoo's order
(largest holders first); date_reported is "YYYY-MM-DD". Empty data means
none reported. On error: {error, detail, symbol} with error
upstream_error.
Ownership breakdown (insider %, institution %, etc.). Use for a
high-level ownership summary.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of Yahoo-native
records {breakdown, value}: value is a fraction (0.66 = 66%) for
*PercentHeld rows and a count for *Count rows. Empty data means
unavailable. On error: {error, detail, symbol} with error
upstream_error.
Top mutual-fund holders of a stock. Use to see the largest fund
positions.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of Yahoo-native
records {date_reported, holder, shares, value, pctheld} in Yahoo's order
(largest first); date_reported is "YYYY-MM-DD". Empty data means none
reported. On error: {error, detail, symbol} with error upstream_error.
Latest news articles for a stock. Use to pull recent headlines and
coverage.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
count: Number of articles (default 10).
tab: One of "news", "all", or "press releases".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of raw Yahoo-native
article dicts in Yahoo's order (most recent first); each has nested
`content` with title, publisher, url, and publish-date fields (exact
shape is Yahoo-native and varies). content.finance.stockTickers
[{symbol}] lists the tickers an article covers (relatedTickers on the
search fallback); check them before treating an item as about this
ticker. Empty data means no articles. On error: {error, detail, symbol}
with error upstream_error.
Forward revenue estimates by period. Use for consensus revenue for coming
quarters and years.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a list of Yahoo-native
records, one per period {period (0q, +1q, 0y, +1y), period_end?,
numberofanalysts, avg, low, high, yearagorevenue, growth,
year_ago_stale?} in Yahoo's period order; growth is a fraction (0.07
= 7%). year_ago_stale: true when the year-ago basis is out of date;
yearagorevenue and growth are then null and period_end may still
name the period just reported. Empty data means none published. On
error: {error, detail, symbol} with error upstream_error.
ESG / sustainability scores for a company. Use for ESG risk context.
Args:
ticker: Symbol — US "AAPL", HK "0700.HK", A-share "600519.SH".
Returns:
dict: {symbol, count, data, source}. data is a single Yahoo-native ESG
record mapping metric name → value (e.g. totalEsg, environmentScore,
socialScore, governanceScore); missing metrics are null. count is 1 when
data exists, else 0 (empty {} when Yahoo has no ESG coverage). On error:
{error, detail, symbol} with error upstream_error.
